description: This file defines API endpoints for an eKYC (electronic Know Your Customer) process using the FastAPI framework. It includes models for request and response payloads, dependency injection for database sessions and user authentication, and routes for initiating eKYC and handling webhook callbacks.

classes.name: EKYCInitiateResponse
classes.description: Response model containing provider reference and initial status after initiating eKYC.

classes.name: EKYCWebhookPayload
classes.description: Model representing the payload received from the eKYC webhook, including status and optional details.

methods.name: initiate(db: Session = Depends(get_db), user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: API endpoint to start a new eKYC process, returning a reference ID and status.

methods.name: webhook(payload: EKYCWebhookPayload, x_ekyc_signature: str = Header(default=""), db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: API endpoint to receive webhook callbacks from the eKYC provider, updating the process status.

ctags.name: provider_ref
ctags.pattern: /^    provider_ref: str = Field(..., description="Reference ID at eKYC provider")$/

ctags.name: provider_ref
ctags.pattern: /^    provider_ref: str = Field(..., description="Reference returned by initiate")$/

ctags.name: status
ctags.pattern: /^    status: str = Field(..., description="approved or rejected")$/

ctags.name: webhook
ctags.pattern: /^def webhook(payload: EKYCWebhookPayload, x_ekyc_signature: str = Header(default=""), db: Session/
ctags.signature: (payload: EKYCWebhookPayload, x_ekyc_signature: str = Header(default=""), db: Session = Depends(get_db))
